subject: SOC2/SIG: Training attestation + transient-access removal logs
body:
From: Michael Sanders <michael.sanders@blueharborhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@blueharborhealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2/SIG evidence request: training attestation + short-lived access removals

Hi Naomi —

We are working through the SIG questionnaire and a couple of items came up related to personnel controls for the Redwood account. Could you provide the following artifacts for our review by EOD Wednesday (2026-08-12)?

- Per-user training completion attestations for the last 12 months (CSV with employee id, role, completion date).
- A short sample (last 30 days) of transient access revocation logs showing which temporary credentials/access were removed after access expiry.
- A redacted sample of a background check as confirmation of redaction process (names redacted ok).

If any of these are handled by another team, please loop them in. Let me know if a DPA or additional paperwork is required to receive redacted personnel artifacts.

Thanks,
Michael Sanders
Security Operations
BlueHarbor Health

-----

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Sanders <michael.sanders@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2/SIG evidence request: training attestation + short-lived access removals

Hi Michael —

Thanks for the clear list. Looping in Ben (Security ops) and Laura (HR lead) to pull the attestation CSV and the revocation logs. Quick clarifying questions before we assemble:

1) For the training CSV, do you need username/email or can we provide a non-PI employee id column?
2) For the revocation logs, is a 30-day sample sufficient, and do you want the raw log format or a CSV summary?
3) For the background check sample, we will provide a single redacted PDF — please confirm name redaction is acceptable.

We may need a DPA addendum before we share redacted background reports; I can send the DocuSign link if needed.

Naomi Feldman
Director, Compliance & Policy
Redwood Inference

-----

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Sanders <michael.sanders@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2/SIG evidence request: training attestation + short-lived access removals

Michael / Naomi / Laura —

Attaching the items we can share immediately:
- training_attestations_2026-07.csv (fields: employee_id, role, module_name, completion_date, training_version)
- transient_access_revocations_2026-08.log (sample lines with timestamp, principal_id, resource, revocation_reason)

Notes and caveats:
- Employee IDs are internal IDs (non-PI). We redacted email addresses from the CSV to maintain PHI/PII minimization. If you need a mapping table for live audits, we will request a signed NDA/DPA addendum.
- Background checks are maintained by HR vendor; we can deliver a single redacted sample but need a DPA prior to transmitting full bundles.
- Our defined SLA for deprovisioning short-lived creds is configured to revoke within 24 hours of expiry/role-change; logs reflect automated revocations plus manual removals by ops.

I will also add an SLA summary doc in the follow-up email so you have the precise policy text and time windows.

Attachments: training_attestations_2026-07.csv, transient_access_revocations_2026-08.log

Regards,
Ben Carter
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference

-----

From: Michael Sanders <michael.sanders@blueharborhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2/SIG evidence request: training attestation + short-lived access removals

Thanks Ben — this looks helpful. A couple of quick follow-ups:

- The CSV layout is fine; the mapping table is not required for the initial review.
- For the revocation log, could you include one or two sample log lines with the full timestamp + principal_id (hashed is fine) in the email body so our reviewers can confirm timestamp granularity?
- For the redacted background sample, redaction of name and SSN is acceptable; we still need to confirm vendor name and check type (national criminal, employment verification). Can you provide just one redacted PDF sample?

Appreciate the SLA note — please include the exact SLA doc so we can reference it in the SIG answers.

Michael

-----

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Sanders <michael.sanders@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2/SIG evidence request: training attestation + short-lived access removals

Michael —

Attaching the redacted sample and the SLA summary as requested. Sample log lines (from transient_access_revocations_2026-08.log):

2026-08-02T03:14:22Z, principal_id: a1b2c3d4-hashed, resource: ephemeral-gcp-sa-prod-cluster, revocation_reason: token_expired
2026-08-09T16:48:05Z, principal_id: e5f6g7h8-hashed, resource: github-actions-deployer, revocation_reason: role_change

Attached: redacted_bgcheck_sample.pdf (name and SSN redacted; vendor: ClearHire; check types: national_criminal, employment_verification)
Attached: onboard-offboard-sla-summary.pdf (includes deprovisioning window and escalation steps)

If you need anything else or prefer the artifacts uploaded to a shared Drive link, say the word and we will push them there.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Compliance & Policy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redacted_bgcheck_sample.pdf (application/pdf), onboard-offboard-sla-summary.pdf (application/pdf)
